query_analysis.expanded_query: Develop a predictive model for eutectic salt formation in a deep eutectic solvent-based extraction process for rare earth elements, focusing on characterizing the thermodynamic boundaries of the system.

selected_agents.role: Thermodynamic boundary characterization and model development
